name: sourcekit-open
description: Source Kit — open provenance core: the auditable capture-signing and verification code, the validation lab, the Desk web app, the CLI, and the attestation relay.

scripts.test: node tests/stage.mjs && npm --prefix tests/.staged install && cd tests/.staged && ./node_modules/.bin/tsx test-verification.mts
scripts.test:all: node tests/stage.mjs && echo 'Staged. Now: cd tests/.staged && npm install, then run any suite: ./node_modules/.bin/tsx test-070-final.mts — full list in README ▸ Reproduce our results and .github/workflows/ci.yml'
scripts.typecheck: node tests/stage.mjs && cd tests/.staged && npm install && npm install --no-save typescript@5.6.3 @types/node@20.14.0 && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM,DOM.Iterable --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --resolveJsonModule $(ls *.mts | grep -v -E '^(test|tool|build)-')
